sources.title: Ministerial Regulation No.55 (B.E.2543), consolidated government copy

sources.title: Town Planning Act B.E.2562, continuation provision
sources.locator: Section 111; BMA record gives effective date 25 November 2019
sources.note: Narrow conclusion: existing comprehensive plans continue pending replacement. Corroborated by the official BMA planning FAQ and 2026 draft consultation. This does not verify complete amendments, overlays or project compliance. Evidence chain: docs/research/legal-evidence-03.md section 8.
sources.issuer: Royal Gazette; official Bangkok government legal record

sources.title: BMA building-control manual: MR41 and MR7 parking guidance
sources.note: Official agency guidance locates 2.10m clear height to lowest soffit, circulation/turning and perpendicular/one-way interaction. Original MR41 Gazette and full amendment/application audit remain unresolved; numeric declarations and schematic geometry do not certify headroom or swept paths.

sources.title: Ministerial Regulation33 with MR50 and MR69 amending instruments
sources.locator: Official OCS bundle: original MR33; MR50 pages21–23; MR69 pages30–38. Separate instruments, not an integrated consolidation.
sources.note: High-rise and extra-large triggers are independent. MR50 replaces definitions and clauses2–8; MR69 adds emergency operating bays. Complete later amendment and parcel applicability audit remains open. See docs/research/legal-evidence-04.md.
